# anthropic_cost_report (Data Source)

Daily cost of a Console organization in USD cents, optionally grouped by workspace or line-item description. Priority Tier costs are not included. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

~> This is a point-in-time report that is re-read on every plan. Use it for outputs and policy checks, not to manage infrastructure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_cost_report" "january" {
  starting_at = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  ending_at   = "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z"
  group_by    = ["workspace_id"]
}

# Amounts are decimal strings in cents.
output "january_total_usd" {
  value = tonumber(data.anthropic_cost_report.january.total_amount) / 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `starting_at` (String) Inclusive start, RFC 3339. Buckets are daily and snap to midnight UTC.

### Optional

- `ending_at` (String) Exclusive end, RFC 3339. At most 31 days.
- `group_by` (List of String) Dimensions to group by: `workspace_id`, `description`.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) Daily buckets, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))
- `total_amount` (String) Sum of every `amount` across all buckets, as a decimal string in cents.

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `ending_at` (String) Bucket end (exclusive).
- `results` (Attributes List) One row per group within the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets--results))
- `starting_at` (String) Bucket start (inclusive).

<a id="nestedatt--buckets--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets.results`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Cost in minor units (cents) as a decimal string.
- `context_window` (String) Context window; null unless grouped by description.
- `cost_type` (String) `tokens`, `web_search`, `code_execution` or `session_usage`; null unless grouped by description.
- `currency` (String) Currency code, currently always `USD`.
- `description` (String) Line-item description; null unless grouped by description.
- `inference_geo` (String) Inference geography; null unless grouped by description.
- `model` (String) Model; null unless grouped by description or for non-token costs.
- `service_tier` (String) Service tier; null unless grouped by description.
- `token_type` (String) Token type; null unless grouped by description.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace id; null unless grouped, and null for the default workspace.
